correctness.rationale: PASS: The F3^2 9-point/9-line incidence model and supported-bijection recursion enumerate exactly 42 distinct one-factors. For each of 861 unordered matching pairs the relative permutation criterion detects a single alternating cycle of length six/eight. Independent enumeration gave 72 hexagon and 108 octagon edges, two size-21 F6 components, 6 F8 isolates and one size-36 component, and F<=8 distance histogram (180,504,177). An additional structural check removed the three degree-six hubs from each hexagon component and found three six-cycles with alternating spokes for each hub pair, establishing the claimed H structure rather than merely degree counts. The argument exhausts a finite graph; no infinite extrapolation.
